normalization_decisions: Quote comparison splits physical lines on both sides, preserving blank separator lines and ignoring only terminal line terminators. Fee contract label 当社負担（契約確認済） explicitly means company-borne confirmed agreement; no fee amount or eligibility expectation changes.
parameters_received = parameters; bank_credits = banks; allowed_fee_jpy = authorized_fee_jpy; amount is parsed integer, amount_jpy remains the original CSV string.
Invoice states: ルール照合済み（人の検収前）=matched, 要確認=needs_review, 未入金=unpaid. Bank states: 割当済み=allocated; 照合保留/不明入金=unallocated; 将来入金=excluded_future.
Candidates include selected allocations as well as unresolved references. Compare selected=false relationships to frozen candidate oracle; selected=true relationships must exactly match allocations.

Future bank unallocated_jpy=null means excluded/not applicable, equivalent to zero contribution in old oracle; raw amount, explicit invoice reference and future scope must remain. Paid invoice due_bucket=残額なし is valid; raw due_on is independently aged for oracle date comparison, with zero overdue balance.
Raw CSV blank contract fields stay blank; customer_id for unregistered bank aliases must remain null. All quote, raw-row, customer and rule links checked independently.
Source quotes compare exact physical line content, ignoring only terminal CR/LF. Per-file inventory supplies hash linkage where per-source hashes are absent.
method: Independent stdlib validator reads saved outputs, frozen held-out oracles, input raw rows and bundle manifests. Employee processing code is neither run, imported nor copied. Final hashes taken after exit0.
limits: Static HTML content and resources; no browser rendering, visibility via CSS, interaction or runtime behavior tested
No human acceptance or real business validation
No external semantic service or network used
